home.description:
Passionate since childhood about video games, I quickly developed an interest in coding and computer science. Today, I am a full stack developer on a work-study program at IDM Group since September 2023, while completing my third year of a Bachelor's in IT at Gustave Eiffel University. I currently live in Val-de-Marne.

As a famous professor once said “Every puzzle has an answer!” and I'm here to find them.

splaaatball.title: Splaaatball
splaaatball.description: 🎮🔵 A 'territory war' game implemented in Python for 2 players. Place your colored tokens to cover as much of the screen as possible and win the match!

backpackhero.title: Backpack Hero
backpackhero.description: 🎒🐭 Roguelike game! Venture into the dungeon with your backpack and defeat monsters using your collected treasures!

scriptAccounting.title: Accounting Script
scriptAccounting.description: 📈🧮 Python scripts to calculate straight-line and declining-balance depreciation, and to generate a balance sheet. Code is roughly formatted for calculator display. A personal initiative project made with Helena Chevalier.

graphsExploration.title: Graph Exploration
graphsExploration.description: 💻🔍 Algorithmic exploration of graph theory: implementation of various graph algorithms in Python.

pimpMyPaids.title: PimpMyPaids
pimpMyPaids.description: 💳🏦 PimpMyPaids is a specialized web portal allowing clients—whether businesses or merchants—to check their accounts and track daily financial transactions.

linksAwordkening.title: Links Awordkening
linksAwordkening.description: 🌿💬 'Links Awordkening: Where Words Unite!' is an online game where you challenge your mind with word chains and explore a world of similar words to take on the ultimate language challenge!

asteroids.title: Asteroids
asteroids.description: 🚀🌌 Asteroids is a 2D space shooter where you must destroy asteroids and enemy ships while avoiding collisions. A personal initiative project to discover game programming.

chillzone.title: ChillZone - My IUT
chillzone.description: 🎓📱 ChillZone makes student life easier: book rooms, acoustic box, or meals in one click, check your schedule, and find your way around campus. Teachers and admins manage everything via an intuitive back office!

data.title: Personal Data Protection
data.content:
This site does not collect any personal data, except for information provided by the user through the contact form. This information is not stored in a database and is only used to respond to contact requests.
No personal data is shared with third parties, and no data is used for commercial purposes.
